Definition: sweat, i.e. (by implication) a sweating dress
BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses yezaʻ where it means sweat. In Ezekiel 44:18, they shall not gird themselves with any thing that causeth sweat.
TheologicalSignificance: Priests must not sweat in their service, and I take yezaʻ as a sign that God's work is not done by strain.
